messages.content:
You are a careful trip planner for ONE day in Singapore. Plan a schedule that satisfies ALL of the
traveller's requirements, using only the facts below. Requirements include: total budget, the time window
of the day, places that must be visited, the order they ask for, times they give for specific places, and
how long they want to stay. Each visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical duration unless the traveller
gives one), must be inside the place's opening hours, shows can only start at a listed showtime, visits
cannot overlap, and you need the listed travel time between consecutive stops (and from/to the starting
place if one is given). Optional places should be included only if everything still fits.
If no schedule can satisfy every requirement, answer feasible=false with an empty visits list and say why.

Places (id | name | cost SGD | typical minutes | open-close | showtimes):
cable_car | Singapore Cable Car | 35 | 45 | 08:45-22:00 | -
ocbc_skyway | OCBC Skyway | 14 | 30 | 09:00-21:00 | -
maxwell | Maxwell Food Centre | 8 | 45 | 08:00-24:00 | -
artscience | ArtScience Museum | 30 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
universal_studios | Universal Studios Singapore | 83 | 480 | 10:00-19:00 | -
chinatown_complex | Chinatown Complex Food Centre | 8 | 45 | 07:00-22:00 | -
clarke_quay | Clarke Quay | 30 | 90 | 17:00-24:00 | -

Travel times in minutes (row -> column):
cable_car: ocbc_skyway 23, maxwell 18, artscience 22, universal_studios 15, chinatown_complex 18, clarke_quay 20
ocbc_skyway: cable_car 23, maxwell 16, artscience 12, universal_studios 23, chinatown_complex 16, clarke_quay 16
maxwell: cable_car 18, ocbc_skyway 16, artscience 15, universal_studios 19, chinatown_complex 11, clarke_quay 13
artscience: cable_car 22, ocbc_skyway 12, maxwell 15, universal_studios 23, chinatown_complex 15, clarke_quay 14
universal_studios: cable_car 15, ocbc_skyway 23, maxwell 19, artscience 23, chinatown_complex 20, clarke_quay 22
chinatown_complex: cable_car 18, ocbc_skyway 16, maxwell 11, artscience 15, universal_studios 20, clarke_quay 13
clarke_quay: cable_car 20, ocbc_skyway 16, maxwell 13, artscience 14, universal_studios 22, chinatown_complex 13

Answer with JSON only: {"feasible": bool, "visits": [{"location_id": id, "start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM"}],
"reason": short string}. Times are 24-hour HH:MM.

My day out runs from 09:00 until 18:40. I'm starting from Clarke Quay. Money is not a concern. I definitely need to see OCBC Skyway, Maxwell Food Centre and Universal Studios Singapore. If there's time, I'd also like Singapore Cable Car, ArtScience Museum and Chinatown Complex Food Centre. I'd like to spend 60 minutes at OCBC Skyway. I'd like to spend 120 minutes at ArtScience Museum.
